## History

Violetta was an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her time living at Mrs. Hammond's house. Imagined as a little echo girl residing in a nearby valley, she served as a close companion to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md). Following Anne's acquisition of a real friend in [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), she found dream girls like Violetta no longer satisfying, leaving the friendship behind.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--violetta.md)

Violetta is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She serves as a comforting presence who echoes Anne's own words back to her. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) engages in real-world activities like attending tea at the manse, Violetta remains a product of her vivid imagination.

- Friend of — imaginary friend who echoed her words  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>
